title: 並列Agentの分割は、file/module所有を重ねないcohesionの高い単位にし、team規模は3-5、taskは1 deliverable単位に揃え、同一file編集・逐次依存の強い作業は単一Sessionまたはsubagentで行う。

problem_titles.H04: Agentごとに仕様・Interfaceの解釈が異なる
problem_titles.H05: 並列変更で通常のMerge conflictが急増する
problem_titles.H07: 分割単位が悪く、複数Agentが同じModuleを横断する
problem_titles.H08: 調整Agentが情報・判断のボトルネックになる

why_not_autonomous: R3 operation or structural decision: source-of-truth / structural choice requires a human decision
existing_capabilities: Claude Code agent teams / subagents guidance: one owner per file set, 3-5 teammates, self-contained tasks (official docs)
Codex subagents guidance: no simultaneous editing across agents; read-heavy work to subagents
Git worktree isolation per parallel implementer (Claude Code Agent isolation: worktree)
options: A: adopt a written decomposition rule for parallel implementation: split by file/module ownership (no shared files), 3-5 agents max, one deliverable per agent, worktree isolation for implementers; sequential or single-session for cross-file/dependent edits; record it in the consumer AGENTS.md or the delegation command
B: keep ad hoc parallelism (status quo) — accept merge conflicts and duplicated reads
C: forbid parallel implementation entirely; parallelize only read-only research/review — safest but loses throughput on independent modules
proposed_action: A for consumers that already run parallel implementers (implement/review commands); C for consumers without ownership boundaries. Structural: it changes how work is decomposed across agents (team topology), a project decision rather than a controller edit.
implementation_target: consumer delegation commands / agent definitions and a one-line AGENTS.md rule; optionally shared guidance in the agent-instruction-maintenance audit criteria once consumers converge
evaluation_plan: on 5 parallel-implementation tasks: files touched by >1 agent (target 0), merge conflicts (target 0), integration turns; adjacent guard: wall-clock not worse than sequential by more than 20% for independent modules

evidence.summary: 『Two teammates editing the same file leads to overwrites. Break the work so each teammate owns a different set of files.』3-5 teammate開始、taskは self-contained unit、逐次/同一file/依存多の作業はteam不向き。
Codex: 『Avoid simultaneous code editing across multiple agents』、read-heavy taskをsubagentへ。
初期systemでは単純queryへ過剰subagent生成・重複が発生。明確なtask境界で解消。
role/workflow修正のみで同一model(GPT-4o)でChatDev成功率+9.4%: 設計（役割・topology）が結果を変える。
ATM: 複数Agentのwrite intentを事前admission（parallel/serialize/fail-closed）で調停する研究。feasibilityのみで比較優位は主張せず。
